patterns: Most PYQs are one-liners: 'Do or Die' = Quit India / Gandhi, launch date and place (8-9 Aug 1942, Bombay), Wardha CWC resolution, Nehru moved the resolution.

Underground figures recur: Usha Mehta (Congress Radio), Lohia (broadcasts), JP (Hazaribagh escape, Azad Dasta), Aruna Asaf Ali; parallel governments Ballia/Satara/Tamluk (APPSC asked Prati Sarkar = Satara).
Traps: Gandhi asked government servants NOT to resign; Linlithgow 'most serious rebellion since 1857'; Do or Die paper was Harijan, not Young India.
App adds a strong Andhra layer (Kurnool Circular, Tenali/Bhimavaram firings) absent from PYQs, plus many generic slogan-matching items that drift off-topic.
